name: Weird Gun Game
desc:
🔫 WELCOME TO WEIRD GUN GAME! 🔫
Forge chaotic creations by fusing gun parts from different weapons and dominate the arena with the weirdest loadouts imaginable!

🛠️ BUILD-UR-GUN!!🛠️
🔧 Click on any part and scroll your mouse wheel to swap barrels, stocks, scopes, and more!
💡 Create cursed combos or meta-breaking monsters it’s your call!

🔥 MASTER THE BATTLEFIELD 🗺️
⚔️ Outgun, outbuild, and outwit your opponents with custom builds!
🎯Sharpen your aim, exploit movement tech, and take control of the fight!
💰 Earn rewards and unlock powerful items and cosmetics as you play!

💖: Credits: Freepik, Textstudio, Charlotte Pollock
